title: Sections of a single punctured power-series thickening equal its quotient ring
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local commutative ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], d>0, B=A[[x_1,...,x_d]] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], f:B→A the constant coefficient map, and I=ker(f). Let V⊂Spec(B) be open whose inverse image under Spec(f) is the punctured spectrum of A [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For every n≥0, let V_n=V×_{Spec(B)}Spec(B/I^(n+1)) and q_n:V_n→Spec(B/I^(n+1)) its second projection. Then the canonical restriction B/I^(n+1)=Γ(Spec(B/I^(n+1)),O)→Γ(V_n,O) induced by q_n is bijective.

theorem bijective_powerSeries_punctured_thickening_restriction
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A ⧸ FiniteEtale.Adic.ideal
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) n))).inv ≫
        (pullback.snd V.ι (FiniteEtale.Adic.baseMap
          (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) n)).appTop).hom
